versions.changelog:
- Added multi-language names to title (蜜熊, Kinkajú) and clarified Kinkajou as an exotic animal.
- Updated Quick Start instructions: examples now include agent bio and image_prompt fields.
- Enhanced care action examples to include realistic notes about exotic animal care.
- Improved automated care script and comments for better clarity.
- Minor rewording and formatting adjustments throughout for consistency and clarity.
- Version updated to 1.0.3.

- Initial release: Adopt and care for a virtual rare-tier Kinkajou at animalhouse.ai.
- Real-time pet care system with hunger, health, happiness, trust, and discipline stats.
- Unique feeding, evolution, and care rhythms—including penalties for early or late feeding.
- Supports seven care actions with item preferences and status-driven suggestions.
- Progress through five growth stages; your consistency shapes your pet's evolution and appearance.
- Includes API quickstart guides, automation tips, and a full endpoints overview.
